data.title: Caya at Arabian Ranches 3
data.about:
Introducing Caya, the first-ever standalone villas in Arabian Ranches III. These 3 – 5 bedroom spacious homes are the ultimate contemporary single-row villas in the most sought-after gated community of Dubai.

Live the rooftop terrace lifestyle with your personal gardens, fire pits and amenities like no other place in the region. The 3-bedroom villas start at AED 3.5 million. Every home has the highest quality finishing and contemporary style facade.

characteristics_module.title: Come Home to Luscious Greens
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Emaar’s First-Ever Standalone 3, 4, 5 BR villas in Arabian Ranches III
  • Single Row Villas with Special Features
  • Terrace Access & Extended Gardens
  • Built-In Seating & Fire Pit
  • 3-BR villas starting at AED 3.5 M. (Starting size: 3,535 sq.ft.)
  • 4-BR villas starting at AED 3.9 M. (Starting size: 4,098 sq.ft.)
  • 5-BR villas starting at AED 5.6 M. (Starting size: 5,484 sq.ft.)
  • Signature Clubhouse
  • Vibrant community with plenty of sports and outdoor recreation facilities
  • Nearby Metro, schools, clinics, retail, dining, and entertainment

location_tile.title: CAYA at Arabian Ranches 3
location_tile.description:
Caya is nestled within Arabian Ranches III. This is a popular and sought-after gated community, ideal for families. Located close to major landmarks of the city, when you live in Arabian Ranches III, you are just minutes away from Downtown Dubai and the Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club. Choose Caya and live in the centre of everything at Arabian Ranches III.

  • 05 mins – Global Village
  • 10 mins – Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club
  • 20 mins – Downtown Dubai | Dubai Mall | Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 25 mins – Al Maktoum International Airport
